patch_description: Structural re-architecture: the processing is organized as an explicit, modular pipeline (noise estimation → RTS pass 1 → inter-pass bilateral damper → RTS Q/4 refinement → guarded reversal damping), implementing the key untested lever: the zero-phase one-pole damper is moved BETWEEN the two RTS passes (alpha ≈ 0.72) instead of running after both. This removes ripple early so the Q/4 refinement pass re-sharpens genuine corners that the damper rounds, while removed ripple stays removed — reducing slope changes and false reversals without the lag cost of terminal damper stacking (which caps at 0.65–0.68 per Gens 42/45). A lag monitor re-checks residual MAD and gates a light terminal polish (alpha=0.9) only when residual ripple exceeds 0.3·σ_r. The velocity clamp is dropped (it produced no improvement) and the code is reorganized into a clean, reusable stage-function architecture with a single RTS engine function, improving maintainability and efficiency.
